name: Hitman Love Strike
source:
To the world, you’re just another office worker, but you’re living a secret double life—thanks to your mysterious powers, you’re able to help those in need… Or you were, until your latest job landed you in the middle of a criminal's plot, and now there’s a price on your head!

First, a hitman, then a handsome government spy, and now a charming con man—it seems like everyone has you in their sights! You wouldn’t mind the attention from such handsome men if it didn’t mean you were the top target on a government hit list.

On top of all of this, the man who deceived you is determined to hunt you down and bring you to his side, whether you want it or not.

Can you master your powers of forgery to stop his nefarious scheme? Or will this dangerous new world prove to be too much for you?

Choose your path in Hitman Love Strike!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.hitman]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
对世人来说，你只是一名办公室职员，但你却过着秘密的双重生活——凭借你神秘的力量，你能够帮助那些需要帮助的人……或者你曾经是这样的，直到你最近的工作让你陷入了犯罪分子的阴谋之中，现在你的人头要被悬赏！

先是杀手，然后是英俊的政府间谍，现在是迷人的骗子——似乎每个人都在瞄准你！如果这不意味着你是政府黑名单上的头号目标，你不会介意这些英俊男人的关注。

最重要的是，欺骗你的人决心追捕你并将你带到他身边，无论你是否愿意。

你能掌握你的伪造能力来阻止他的邪恶计划吗？或者这个危险的新世界会让你无法承受吗？

在《Hitman Love Strike》中选择你的道路！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.hitman]Google Play[/url]]
